name: Data Browser Depricarping (Web)
implementation_notes: DepricarpingRecordService/Controller/routes/seeder/factories are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Depricarping screens (051/055/059), mirroring PressingRecordService's precedent (screen-050) -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence

DepricarpingRecord/DepricarpingDetail/DepricarpingOperationalTarget Eloquent models and their 3 migrations already existed prior to this task (generated by an earlier impl-1-core/entity-models pass covering all 4 new stations, including the 4-column operational-target migration) -- this screen's work only added the service/controller/routes/seeder/factories/Livewire layer on top of that existing schema, no new migrations were needed

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, replacing the original fixed 24-row design the user explicitly rejected): DepricarpingRecordService::create()/update()'s row-population logic changed to mirror PressingRecordService's just-fixed pattern exactly -- create() now inserts only the given detail rows (1..24, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) instead of forcing exactly 24, update() upserts by id (insert rows without an id, update rows whose id still appears, delete any existing row whose id is no longer present) instead of UPDATE-only; the 3 Eloquent models/migrations listed above did NOT need to change, only the service's row-handling methods (create()/update()/validateDetails()/upsertDetails(), replacing insertDetails()/updateDetails())

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across all 8 reading columns (mirrors PressingRecordService's/ThreshingRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern exactly, adapted for Depricarping's own column names: fan_static_pressure_mmh2o, polishing_drum_speed_rpm, air_velocity_ms, fibre_moisture_percent, kernel_recovery_in_fibre_percent, nut_silo_1_temp_c, nut_silo_2_temp_c, downtime_minutes, findings) -- UNCHANGED by this revision, this Data Browser screen never assumed a fixed 24-row count
StationFactory gained a new depricarping() state (type=StationType::Depricarping), mirroring pressing()/threshing() exactly, needed by the whole Depricarping test suite

DepricarpingRecordServiceTest.php rewritten to mirror PressingRecordServiceTest.php's dynamic-row test shape (create() with 1..N rows instead of always-24, update() upsert semantics including delete-on-removal) -- 32 tests total (up from the pre-fix 29)

Ran the full backend Pest suite after this pass: 1287/1287 passing (up from the pre-fix baseline of 1275/1275), confirming zero regressions across Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping and every other station

DatabaseSeeder.php updated to call DepricarpingOperationalTargetSeeder (registered after PressingOperationalTargetSeeder) so a fresh `php artisan db:seed` run seeds the 6 reference rows going forward; migrations for all 3 depricarping_* tables were already applied on the dev database.sqlite prior to this pass (confirmed via `php artisan migrate:status`), consistent with the project-level entity-models groundwork

known_issues.description: Production Process Activity (Web) (screen-035, out of this 6-screen task's scope) still only renders 3 active station tiles (Weighbridge/Grading/Cages Track) -- confirmed still true after this pass. It has not been updated to add a Depricarping tile linking to /data/depricarping. This screen is reachable directly by URL/route but not yet from that entry-point grid. Needs a separate revision of screen-035 (shared across all 4 new-station agent runs, not owned by any single one -- Threshing's/Pressing's implement artifacts document the identical gap).

Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DataBrowserDepricarpingTest.php) was authored following this codebase's established convention (a .php file containing Playwright TS syntax, excluded from phpunit.xml's testsuites, meant to be run separately via `playwright test` against a live dev server) but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review, consistent with every other Browser/* spec in this codebase.
